import asyncio,json,pathlib
from mcp import Client

URL="https://qrflow.codes/mcp"

async def main():
    async with Client(URL) as client:
        tools=await client.list_tools()
        out={
          "schema":"PROJECT_BRAIN_MCP_SUPPLIER_PROBE_V1",
          "url":URL,
          "protocol_version":str(client.protocol_version),
          "server_info":str(client.server_info),
          "tools":[
            {
              "name":t.name,
              "title":getattr(t,"title",None),
              "description":getattr(t,"description",None),
              "input_schema":getattr(t,"input_schema",None)
            } for t in tools.tools
          ]
        }
        p=pathlib.Path("canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-MCP-QRFLOW-PROBE-001__TOOLS.json")
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True,default=str)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
        print("MCP_QRFLOW_TOOLS_DISCOVERED",len(out["tools"]))
        print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True,default=str)[:12000])

asyncio.run(main())
